post.description: Stores the mapping (recorded_at and amount are required), then returns each distinct account and category value of the file with the existing one it most likely stands for, plus the existing accounts and categories to choose from, and moves the import to the values step.

post.summary: Import the uploaded spreadsheet as records
post.description: Accounts are mapped to an existing account ("existing" with id), created ("create", named after the value unless a name is given) or sent to the "Unmapped" account ("unmapped"); rows without an account also go there. Categories are mapped to an existing category, created (one per record type) or left uncategorized ("none"); an existing category of another type than the record is swapped for the same-named one of the record type, created if missing. Invalid rows are skipped and reported. Without a type column the amount sign decides: negative is an expense. The import is removed afterwards.

types.description: The values of the type column that mean each record type, separated by commas. Values left out are recognized by name (income, expense, transfer, pemasukan, pengeluaran).

get.description: Every call to the webhook public endpoint (status, origin, IP, payload, created record), newest first. The latest 500 are kept.

post.summary: Add a record through a webhook
post.description: Public endpoint. The body carries the record fields and a `signature`; the X-Webhook-Timestamp and X-Webhook-Nonce headers are signed with them. The webhook is the one whose token reproduces the signature. Only income and expense records are accepted. A missing or invalid signature, a stale timestamp, or a reused nonce returns 401 and an inactive webhook 404.

parameters.name: X-Webhook-Timestamp
parameters.description: Unix time (seconds) the request was signed at. Must be within 5 minutes of the server time.

parameters.name: X-Webhook-Nonce
parameters.description: A unique value (16-128 characters) per request. Each nonce is accepted once, so a replayed request is rejected with 401.

signature.description: The hex HMAC-SHA256, keyed by the webhook token, of "timestamp=..&nonce=..&type=..&account_name=..&category_id=..&amount=..&note=..&recorded_at=.." (timestamp and nonce are the header values; missing record fields are empty).

403.description: The caller IP address, the record type or the account is not allowed for this webhook

401.description: Missing or invalid signature or headers, a stale timestamp, or a reused nonce

allowed_account_ids.description: Accounts records may be added to. Empty allows every account.

allowed_types.description: Record types that may be added. Empty allows every type.

allowed_ips.description: Whitelisted IP addresses or CIDR ranges, one per line (or comma separated). Empty allows every address.

post.description: Dry run of POST /webhooks/records for a logged-in user: takes the same signed request (X-Webhook-Timestamp and X-Webhook-Nonce headers, signature in the body) and runs the same checks, but saves nothing and does not use up the nonce.

ip.description: IP address to check against the whitelist (only needed when IPs are whitelisted).

200.description: Payload is valid and the webhook is active
